push.title: W 4-0 vs Gerth United | You: 9.4 (first match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, your first match performance: a 9.4. Fresh-baked-pie good.

DID WELL
+ 2 key passes. Every key pass is a love letter to a teammate.
+ A brace against Gerth United. Defenders can draw up all the plans they want; you just scored anyway.
+ Man of the Match. Frame it, then hang it where your mama can see it.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.
+ 2 shots on target: +0.1. You did the boring stuff well, and it showed.

WORK ON
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Think about this: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. Practice makes permanent.
- 67% passing (14 of 21). Coach's secret: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back. Bread and butter.
- Same defensive work rate trouble for you and BellyTb1. Buddy up: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 3 shots off target took 0.1. Better decisions, better rating.
- Passes attempted: 21. Aim for 25+.

Coach's drill: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

tuxedo_slide, something I want you to sleep on: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

Proud of you, partner. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-0 vs Gerth United | You: 8.7 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
Your 2nd best match performance, PhogsToffees. An 8.7. That's the stuff.

DID WELL
+ 7 shots at Gerth United's goal. You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota.
+ A goal against Gerth United, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's the sound of the scoreboard saying thank you.
+ 1 key pass. That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ You and tuxedo_slide were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ 0.8 above your norm. That's what effort compounds into.

WORK ON
- 1 of 7 shots on target. Easy win: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. I've seen you do harder things.
- 47% passing (9 of 19, down from your usual 74%). Remember this: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Like riding a bike.
- tuxedo_slide had the same forcing passes gremlin. Squash it together: give each other short options.

Kickabout task: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

Listen here, PhogsToffees: Good passes are like good manners. Free, and people remember.

If I had a gold star sticker, you'd get the whole sheet. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-0 vs Gerth United | You: 7.8 (3rd best match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.8. Like a good casserole, it's not fancy, but everybody's glad it showed up.

DID WELL
+ A goal against Gerth United. You found the corner like it owed you rent.
+ 7.8: your 3rd best match performance. Remember how that felt.
+ 4-0 win. Enjoy it, then get ready for the next one.

WORK ON
- 63% passing (12 of 19). Homework: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy. Easy money.
- Only 2 tackles attempted. From the clipboard: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Simple as pie: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle. No sweat, just reps.
- Both you and tuxedo_slide dipped on defensive work rate. Lean on each other: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Passes attempted: 19. 25+ is where top midfielders hang their hats.

Tonight's homework: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.

BellyTb1, write this on your hand if you have to: The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

One step at a time, partner. - Coach Lasso
